key_insight: VIBES replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial objective that encourages reinforcement-learning representations to preserve reward and dynamics information while ignoring distractors.
engineering_relevance: As a drop-in replacement for Dreamer’s model-learning component, VIBES targets distractor-robust control from both images and high-dimensional vector states.
method: Use an adversarial objective to enforce reward and next-latent-state prediction sufficiency.
Constrain latent capacity to encourage retention of task-relevant information.
Establish that global optima induce bisimulation relations on histories when exact sufficiency is attainable.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art Distracting Control Suite performance, evaluations in Realistic ManiSkill and on a 100-link swimmer, and latent-space probes supporting distractor invariance.
watch_item: The bisimulation guarantee assumes exact sufficiency is attainable; practical results may depend on latent capacity and adversarial optimization.
paper_title: Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation
